Mechanism checked: on each row interest_rate keeps the tag's float (10.549999999999999, 9.950000000000001, ...) while the corrected pik_rate is the printed two-decimal value, so the unrounded subtraction leaves the residue; the other 48 corrected rows subtract to exactly 0.0. The proposed check (a non-zero rate field below 1e-9 in absolute size) is exact and has no legitimate positives; rounding in the shared subtraction is the real fix.
